heading: Other property subject to forfeiture
lead: There may be seized and forfeited to the United States the following:

tree.heading: Counterfeit stamps
tree.text: Every stamp involved in the offense described in section 7208 (relating to counterfeit, reused, cancelled, etc., stamps), and the vellum, parchment, document, paper, package, or article upon which such stamp was placed or impressed in connection with such offense.

tree.heading: False stamping of packages
tree.text: Any container involved in the offense described in section 7271 (relating to disposal of stamped packages), and of the contents of such container.

tree.heading: Fraudulent bonds, permits, and entries
tree.text: All property to which any false or fraudulent instrument involved in the offense described in section 7207 relates.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1976 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 94–455 effective on first day of first month which begins more than 90 days after Oct. 4, 1976, see section 1904(d) of Pub. L. 94–455, set out as a note under section 4041 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1974 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 93–490 applicable to filled cheese manufactured, imported, or sold after Oct. 26, 1974, see section 3(c) of Pub. L. 93–490, set out as an Effective Date of Repeal note under sections 4831 to 4834 of this title.
